name: tidelight-app
description: Tidelight phone app: the website's pages in a Capacitor shell, with on-phone saving, age setup, and sharing for the Daily check-in. Draft, not reviewed.

scripts.test: node tools/lint.mjs && node --test test/unit/*.test.mjs && node tools/build.mjs && node test/logic-test.mjs && node test/app-test.mjs && node test/extras-test.mjs && node test/redesign-test.mjs && node test/crisis-test.mjs && node test/safety-test.mjs && node test/a11y-test.mjs && node test/budget-test.mjs && node test/resilience-test.mjs && node test/network-test.mjs && node test/pages-test.mjs
scripts.test:safety: node tools/lint.mjs && node --test test/unit/safety-rules.test.mjs test/unit/streaks.test.mjs test/unit/reviewed-strings.test.mjs test/unit/tokens.test.mjs test/unit/quiet.test.mjs && node tools/build.mjs && node test/crisis-test.mjs && node test/safety-test.mjs
scripts.sim:launch: xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process booted org.tidelight.app -TidelightQuiet YES
